import hashlib,json,os,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('/home/lucky/devdir/rgzndl');folder=ROOT/'results/diagnostics/frozen_learning_v1'
r=json.loads((folder/'report.json').read_text());v=json.loads((folder/'verification.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert v['status']=='passed' and v['report_sha256']==sha(folder/'report.json')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as config:
 os.environ['MPLCONFIGDIR']=config
 import matplotlib
 matplotlib.use('Agg')
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 families=['svm','cnn_clean','resnet_clean','resnet_aug'];names=['SVM','CNN','ResNet','Aug. ResNet']
 def stats(family,split,mode):
  x=[e['metrics']['accuracy']*100 for e in r['metrics'] if e['family']==family and e['split']==split and e['mode']==mode]
  return float(np.mean(x)),None if len(x)==1 else float(np.std(x,ddof=1))
 output=folder/'figures';output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.5),layout='constrained')
 for offset,split,color in [(-.18,'train','#426e9c'),(.18,'validation','#c8843b')]:
  xs=np.arange(4)+offset; ss=[stats(f,split,'frozen') for f in families]
  bars=axes[0].bar(xs,[s[0] for s in ss],width=.34,label=split.capitalize(),color=color)
  for i,(mean,sd) in enumerate(ss):
   if sd is not None:axes[0].errorbar(xs[i],mean,yerr=sd,fmt='none',ecolor='#222',capsize=3)
   axes[0].text(xs[i],mean+(sd or 0)+1,f'{mean:.1f}',ha='center',fontsize=8)
 axes[0].set_xticks(np.arange(4),names,rotation=15);axes[0].set_ylim(0,80)
 axes[0].set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)');axes[0].set_title('Frozen saved models');axes[0].legend()
 rows=[]
 for split in ['train','validation']:
  for channel in range(2):
   q=r['input_summary'][split]['normalized_sample_dc_quantiles'][channel]
   rows.append((f'{split} {"IQ"[channel]}',q['0.1'],q['0.5'],q['0.9']))
 for i,(label,lo,mid,hi) in enumerate(rows):
  axes[1].plot([lo,hi],[i,i],color='#426e9c' if i<2 else '#c8843b',lw=5,alpha=.7)
  axes[1].scatter([mid],[i],color='#222',s=22,zorder=3)
 axes[1].set_yticks(range(4),[x[0] for x in rows]);axes[1].invert_yaxis()
 axes[1].axvline(0,color='#aaa',ls='--',lw=1);axes[1].set_xlabel('Mean over time after frozen train normalization')
 axes[1].set_title('Per-sample DC: p10–p90 and median')
 fig.suptitle('Learning diagnostics: train / validation only',fontsize=13)
 fig.text(.01,-.045,'Network error bars: sample SD across 3 training seeds. SVM: one deterministic model. No test inference.',fontsize=9)
 for ext in ('png','svg'):fig.savefig(output/f'frozen_learning.{ext}',dpi=180,bbox_inches='tight')
 plt.close(fig)
 fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.4),layout='constrained')
 for ax,split in zip(axes,['train','validation']):
  for off,mode,color,label in [(-.23,'frozen','#426e9c','Frozen running statistics'),(0,'batch_stats_order_20261002','#c8843b','Batch statistics: order A'),(.23,'batch_stats_order_20261003','#6c9b72','Batch statistics: order B')]:
   ss=[stats(f,split,mode) for f in families[1:]]
   ax.bar(np.arange(3)+off,[x[0] for x in ss],width=.22,color=color,label=label)
   ax.errorbar(np.arange(3)+off,[x[0] for x in ss],yerr=[x[1] for x in ss],fmt='none',ecolor='#333',capsize=2)
  ax.set_xticks(range(3),names[1:]);ax.set_ylim(0,60);ax.set_title(split.capitalize());ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)')
 axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
 fig.suptitle('BatchNorm counterfactual: diagnostic only',fontsize=13)
 fig.text(.01,-.045,'Batch-statistics predictions depend on other samples in the batch; these are not deployment or improvement scores.',fontsize=9)
 for ext in ('png','svg'):fig.savefig(output/f'bn_counterfactual.{ext}',dpi=180,bbox_inches='tight')
 plt.close(fig)
 for p in output.glob('*.svg'):p.write_text('\n'.join(x.rstrip() for x in p.read_text().splitlines())+'\n',newline='\n')
 provenance=dict(report_sha256=sha(folder/'report.json'),verification_sha256=sha(folder/'verification.json'),
  script=Path(__file__).read_text(),script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),matplotlib_version=matplotlib.__version__,
  files_sha256={p.name:sha(p) for p in output.iterdir()},scope='Train/validation fixed weights only; BN counterfactual not deployable score')
 (output/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n',newline='\n')
 print('figures',list(provenance['files_sha256']))
